subject: Runtime resource authorization request + offer band guidance
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, HR Operations <hr-ops@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime resource authorization request + offer band guidance

Team,

Requesting authorization to open a small slate of hires for the Runtime/Platform org focused on improving throughput and lowering tail latency for production customers. Summary below; packet attached (runtime_hc_packet_v1.pdf) and comp band matrix.

What I'm proposing
- 1 Principal Runtime Engineer (level 6) — lead kernel/compilation work; immediate hire (open headcount)
- 1 Senior SRE (level 5) — production SLOs and incident reduction playbook; hire in Q3
- 1 Software Engineer, Runtime (level 5) — performance/quantization work; hire in Q3

Why now
- Observability shows 12% p99 latency regressions on long-context workloads month-over-month.
- We have committed SLAs for two customers (CloudOps pilot + Dedicated alpha) that need immediate mitigations.

Comp bands and asks
- Attached comp_band_matrix.xlsx includes target cash + equity ranges for each level and a recommended offer cushion to move quickly. For the Principal role I recommend a 10% above midpoint authority.
- Total OTE + burdened cost estimate is in the packet.

Asks
1) Approve opening these 3 reqs and the compensation guardrails in the attached matrix.
2) Permission to extend an initial offer to the Principal role up to midpoint +10% without an extra exec loop to avoid losing candidates.
3) Confirmation on staging: hire Principal now; the two level-5 hires in Q3 unless finance flags required.

If approved I will: finalize JD, brief Talent (Julie at TalentPlacers CC'd), and share an offer structure for the Principal role.

Attachments: runtime_hc_packet_v1.pdf, comp_band_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, HR Operations <hr-ops@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime resource authorization request + offer band guidance

Thanks Kim — useful packet. A few quick asks before I can sign off: 

- Can you tighten the Principal band request from midpoint +10% to midpoint +7% as a default and include a short note explaining the specific market data that justifies the +10% exception (if we do it)? I want the exception to be explicit.
- For the two level-5 hires, propose staging them as: one in July (start pipeline now) and one in September (offer only once we see sustained improvement in p99).
- Please add a hiring-risk note (impact on recruiter capacity + ramp time) and a fallback plan if we can only secure contractors in H2.

I will need a costed headcount sheet (burdened comp + ramp assumptions) for Marcus to sign off. If Marcus confirms budget by EOD we can let Talent place the Principal in the market next week.

On the approval authority: I'd be comfortable giving you permission to extend up to midpoint +7% immediately; anything above requires my explicit approval with the justification memo.

- Soojin
VP, Infrastructure

Kim/Soojin — reviewed the packet and did a quick cost sensitivity analysis. Notes below: 

- Burdened cost (salary + benefits + payroll taxes + HW allowance) estimates: Principal (L6) = $330k/year; Senior SRE (L5) = $190k/year; Runtime SE (L5) = $185k/year. I used the comp_band_matrix.xlsx ranges and a conservative 18% benefits multiplier.
- Equity: recommend smaller initial refreshers for hires at L6 (to keep total comp within budget) and front-loaded signing for Principal if we need to be aggressive.
- Headcount phasing: agree with staging (Principal now, 1x L5 July, 1x L5 Sept). If we accelerate both L5s to July, incremental FY26 run-rate impact is +$220k.
- Ask: Kimberly, please include a 12-month ramp assumption per hire in the HC sheet (0.6/1.0 productivity). That affects our FY26 risk bucket.

I can approve the baseline cost plan under the following conditions: 1) Principal offers capped at midpoint +7% (exception memo required to exceed), 2) you provide the final costed headcount sheet and the updated packet by EOD. Once I have that I will push budget approval to Finance.

Marcus
Finance Manager, Planning & Analysis
